wearable.title: Pet Wearable Device
wearable.description: Tailing is a Talktail exclusive wearable device that measures pet vital data in real-time. It is a B2B-focused medical assistant device that increases both diagnostic accuracy and owner trust.

ai_diagnosis.title: AI Analysis of Pet Skin Diseases
ai_diagnosis.description: Talktail Care is a non-face-to-face care solution that analyzes your pet's skin with a single photo, delivers the results through trained AI, and then connects Talktail Solutions to a hospital.
